author: tomalin
body:
#### PR description:

This PR tidies up & updates procedures for generating Monte Carlo of cosmic rays traversing the P2 Tracker Cosmic Rack test system. (The original procedures were developed by @hayfasfar )

1) The original cfg.py jobs for the GEN-SIM & DIGI steps have been replaced with a single customise.py file used as an argument of cmsDriver.py

2) The documentation has been moved to the doc/ directory and updated to refer to the new customize.py file.

3) The customize.py file has been updated to:

a) Use a "cosmic" flag to relax the bend cut used when making TTStubs.
b) Added MC truth info (TrackingParticles) and truth association for clusters & stubs.
c) Tightened the cosmic generator cuts to match better the Cosmic Rack acceptance.
title: Update to scripts to create P2 Tracker Cosmic Rack MC
